messages:
jordan: uploaded a sliceprof heatmap for the A/B run — https://console.redwood/ops/dash/heatmap/1750012345 :eyes:
sara: quick skim — v3-quant shows a clear spike in token tail for /summarize at >99.9th, looks like extra kernel hops around token 1200-1400
miguel: checked kv metrics — v3-quant kv_hit_rate = 0.62 vs v3-small = 0.77. heatmap lines up with lower KV hits (more full-attend kernel paths)
alisha: can you paste the query you used for the token-level waterfall? want to reproduce in the console before poking runtime
jordan: sure — query I ran in metrics playground:
```
sum by (model,route,percentile) (histogram_quantile(0.999, rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) )
|> filter(route =~ \"/summarize|/chat\")
|> group_by(model, route)
```
that produced the percentiles used to color the heatmap
ben: another datapoint — the batch scheduler for v3-quant flipped from continuous to reshaped batching on that build. reshaped increases kernel count per token when sequence lengths in batch vary — might explain extra tail latency
ci-bot: deploy-canary: v3-quant rollout to canary pool completed at 1750011600 — metrics snapshot attached (qps, p50/p95/p99/parsing)
sara: i'll try a cache-warm run with prefix prefetch + pin kv-policy to verify if hit-rate explains it. kicking off experiment now (exp id: perf-heatmap-14)
miguel: also confirm compiler flags — last compile for v3-quant showed `use_fused_attention=false` in toolchain metadata, whereas v3-small used fused true. different kernels expected. can someone grep the build metadata?
alisha: if we need to rollback, we can route 100% of traffic for /summarize back to v3-small via routing policy. but would prefer to root-cause first. can we get a per-route KPI delta (p50/p95/p99 + kv_hit) for the last 24h?
jordan: i pulled a quick per-route diff: /summarize p50 +2ms, p95 +12ms, p99 +34ms for v3-quant vs v3-small; kv_hit -15pp; qps -7% on the canary pool
ben: those numbers map to the observed user SLOs — 18% increase in observed error budget burn for summarize route (mostly tail latency)
sara: pause the rest of the rollout. i'll open a tiny instrumentation PR to log `selected_kernel` and `kv_key_len` per request (sampling 1/1000) so we can correlate heatmap lines to kernel decisions
ci-bot: ticket created PERF-4823 - "A/B v3-quant token-tail regression — heatmap + kernel flags" — https://issues.redwood/PERF-4823
miguel: i'll recompile v3-quant with fused attention on and rerun a small canary to see if kernel path collapses
alisha: thanks. once we have per-request `selected_kernel` we can build a dashboard slice that cross-tabs kernel name vs kv_hit vs route percentile. that should make root cause obvious
sara: agreed — update after experiment finishes (~30m). will post results here :thumbsup:
